scope.intent: replace the Node downloader with the Rust zos-downloader service and complete the reliability upgrade

appliedFixes: Corrected Rust SQL construction and added database state-machine tests.
Fenced and identity-checked publish journals, added live-publisher file locking, and synchronized parent directories during recovery.
Stopped leases on control requests, preserved cancel priority, and made panic recovery reclaimable.
Hardened validators, redirect downgrade policy, address fallback, retry jitter, and transient error classification.
Fixed ACL ordering and segmented speed checkpoints.
Added controlled HTTP, checksum, size-limit, control, publication, and legacy-upgrade tests.

testingGaps: A real Debian package and systemd service were not installed on the macOS review host.
Power-loss, physical NAS detach/reattach, and forced kill acceptance require a Linux NAS test environment.
residualRisks: Rollback requires restoring the pre-upgrade database and downloader partial files together because segmented partials may be sparse.
Linux ACL and openat2 behavior is cross-compiled and source-tested but still requires target-filesystem acceptance.

verification.debianPackage: not built locally; Linux release gate
